## Classification rules
Priority: spam, then sales, then support, else general.
Spam: casino, crypto, viagra, the phrase "seo backlinks", the word "backlink", or 3 or more http/https/www links.
Sales: price, quote, or order.
Support: error, broken, refund, or help.
Matching is a case-insensitive substring of the message.
The webhook answers with JSON {category, row}.

## Production swap
This demo stores rows in the built-in Data table node (table name smb_inquiries).
No external credential is required.
In production, replace Append Inquiry Row with Google Sheets "Append row" and map name, email, company, message, category, received_at.
Add an email node after that when a person should be notified.
DEMO DATA only. Addresses use example.com.
